info.prompt: Neo-Gothic cybernetic autopsy table, low-angle shot: a glowing cyan heart suspended in a skeletal gold cage pulses at 140 BPM, each beat sending electric magenta shockwaves through translucent dice arranged on a black obsidian slab, the walls crawling with synaptic geometry that rewrites itself in real-time to the rhythm of a flatlining neural oscillator, vignette darkness creeping inward like a failing life-support system.
